comment: Hand-checked rowing stretches for river clubs, answered by the owner on 2026-10-28. Read by scripts/build_river_sections.py on top of the general rule: to the next weir or lock up to 25 km each way; on open rivers to a river mouth, a big tributary or a big harbour 3-15 km away, else 12 km upstream and 8 km downstream (10 and 10 on canals). club id -> "bounds" (what ends the stretch, in words), "include" (extra waters that belong to the stretch), "direction" (compass side of the boathouse the club rows on, where a lock or weir sits right at it), "behindKm" (how far the other side still counts, for the water in front of the boathouse), "note".

ruder-club-mark.bounds: the three weirs around the boathouse: on the Obergraben just past the launch point, on the Ruhr below the Harkortsee, and on the parallel Ruhr arm next to the Obergraben
ruder-club-mark.note: rows from the Obergraben into the Harkortsee, which is the Ruhr there

bessel-ruder-club.note: Weser only; the Mittellandkanal needs a lock

wilhelmsburger-ruder-club-von-1895.note: rows on the Wilhelmsburg canals and the Elbe

papenburger-ruderclub.note: mainly the Ems, also the Papenburg canals

ruderverein-luedinghausen-1925.note: the Alte Fahrt is short, include all of it

frankfurter-ruder-club-von-1882.bounds: on the Alte Oder from the weir near the boathouse to the Oder; on the Oder both ways by the general rule
frankfurter-ruder-club-von-1882.note: rows the Alte Oder out to the Oder

lueneburger-ruder-club-wiking-v1875.note: rows north toward Bardowick, plus the water right in front of the Willy-Brandt-Straße boathouse (owner 2026-10-28). Three boathouses: Willy-Brandt-Straße 15 on the Ilmenau, Am Schifferwall 6 on the Lösegraben (an Ilmenau arm; place lueneburger-ruder-club-wiking-v1875-loesegraben) and Elso-Klöver-Straße on the Elbe-Seitenkanal (place lueneburger-ruder-club-wiking-v1875-elbe-seitenkanal)

breisacher-ruderverein.note: boathouse on the Rheinuferstr. in Breisach; rows south from the slip (owner checked 2026-10-29)

karlsruher-ruder-verein-wiking-von-1879.note: launch point at the boathouse in the Rheinhafen (Hansastr. 18 b), rows out onto the Rhine

passauer-ruderverein-von-1874.note: rows on the Inn south of the weir (owner 2026-11-02)

universitaet-passau-sportzentrum.note: rows on the Inn south of the weir (owner 2026-11-02)

muendener-ruderverein.note: Fulda, Werra and the waters joining them (owner 2026-11-02)

ruderriege-grotefend-gymnasium-muenden.note: Fulda, Werra and the waters joining them (owner 2026-11-02)

ruderverein-uelzen.note: Elbe-Seitenkanal and the basin beside it (owner 2026-11-02)

wassersportverein-koenigs-wusterhausen.note: Dahme and the lakes around Königs Wusterhausen (owner 2026-11-02)

wuerzburger-ruderverein-bayern-von-18751.note: Main and its side arms nearby (owner 2026-11-02)
